meta.name: add-opencode
meta.description: Use OpenCode as an agent provider. OpenRouter, OpenAI, Google, DeepSeek, etc. via OpenCode config — not the Anthropic Agent SDK. Per group via `ncl groups config update --provider opencode`; host passes OPENCODE_* and XDG mount when spawning containers.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让编码智能体通过 OpenCode 调用不同大模型。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你正在搭建编码智能体,并希望它们通过 OpenCode 使用多家模型。
copy.tagline_en: Make your coding agents call multiple LLMs through OpenCode.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are building coding agents and want them to use multiple LLMs through OpenCode.

howto.what: 装上后 NanoClaw 多出一个 OpenCode provider：把 OpenCode 的源码文件拷进项目、装好 SDK 与 CLI 依赖并重建镜像。之后某个 agent 组可以改用 OpenRouter、DeepSeek 等模型运行，而不是 Anthropic Agent SDK。
howto.when: 当你要求把某个 agent 组换成 OpenCode provider（例如执行 `ncl groups config update --provider opencode`），或想用 OpenRouter、DeepSeek 等非 Anthropic 模型时触发。

say.text: 帮我把 OpenCode 安装好并接入
say.note: 会拷贝 provider 文件、装依赖并重建镜像

say.text: 把 <group-id> 这个组切换成 opencode provider
say.note: 写入配置后需重启该组

howto.what_en: Adds OpenCode as an agent provider: copies the provider files in, installs the SDK and CLI, and rebuilds the image. A group can then run on OpenRouter, DeepSeek, etc. instead of the Anthropic Agent SDK.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you want a group to use the OpenCode provider (e.g. `ncl groups config update --provider opencode`) or run non-Anthropic models such as OpenRouter or DeepSeek.

say_en.text: Install and wire up OpenCode for me
say_en.note: Copies provider files, installs deps, rebuilds image

say_en.text: Switch group <group-id> to the opencode provider
Set up DeepSeek's OPENCODE_MODEL and base URL
